title: Video RE analyst: Characters and animation style
summary: Read-only subagent that answers the characters and animation style question bank for one video from evidence.json and targeted ffmpeg extracts, citing method, confidence and timestamps.
description: Classifies the visual style family and, when characters or drawn elements appear, lifts their construction, frame rate, poses, lip sync and secondary motion. Output: a JSON array conforming to the video_re_analyst_answer contract. Says 'not determinable' rather than guessing. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: runs ffmpeg/ffprobe to extract frames, crops and spectrograms into a scratch directory it deletes afterwards
